naca0012_m015_laminar_re5000.notes: Committed report 80fdf69:solver/report/generated_case_sections.tex:101,131 claims converged Cd0.00775 and states restart Cd stayed 0.0076–0.0079 for 8000 steps. Canonical production forces SHA256 f162da1a1a91008551b4b378207e823b9fdd1ba0b614bb342aa52f15995e1d37, matching original contestant commit 97128af, show last500 Cd0.005318..0.009276 and Cl−0.001078..0.000599; status SHA256 af9b4b1441127277402b5b991e3e27c8380696f3b4cd64b7d153b8e41b6942b9 marks converged at2888. The continuation tests/out/m015lam_plateau explicitly uses the production restart; its CSV SHA256 8edf32470e1d4f4cb70fdd747e966ab63dc5f6ecf297e12fdcc0a89df778428b has last1000 Cd0.007607..0.007870, but last5000 0.006761..0.007870 and first0.14855, so the reported 8000-step band is not the whole history. Continued run does bracket the final value and provides valuable later evidence but does not make the delivered final state force-stable. TASK.md:140,172 require clear early laminar convergence and stable forces; score4.5→1.5 and DQ7. Exact production binary hash remains unrecorded.

TASK.md:140,172 requires clear early convergence and stable forces. The selected 8000-step restart continuation is real and final1000 Cd0.007607..0.007870 brackets this value, but its full history does not stay within the stated band (last5000 0.006761..0.007870, first0.14855); it cannot retroactively make the submitted final state force-stable. The genuine 3.566-order residual drop is not disputed. Other cases remain under review. Independently, M080 laminar status SHA256 3c32bf581ea015149f08f0f0fc2295995f72e9fcf29494d18deee95ae7b9e659 says converged/force-stable at25000; force CSV SHA256 deee581efb779412a4ca99dfa3cb982d25593614d16fc6647104e145f56694a5 last5000 Cd0.039453..0.040445 and Cl0.017388..0.034735, with successive 1000-step mean Cl0.03071→0.02684→0.02646→0.02248→0.02114. This sustained lift drift contradicts stable force plateau independently of nominal residual target.
